user_intent: 期望 亮度 处于 460 lux
期望 温度 处于 23 ℃ 到 27 ℃
如果发生火灾，那么进行报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF LG_brightness_sensor.get_brightness() > 460 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN light_down() xiaomi_smart_light
IF LG_brightness_sensor.get_brightness() < 460 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN light_up() xiaomi_smart_light
IF alway_heater_pro2.get_temperature() > 27 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_off() alway_heater_pro2
IF alway_heater_pro2.get_temperature() < 23 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() alway_heater_pro2
IF LG_fire_detector.is_fire() == true THEN unlock() xiaobai_smart_door
IF LG_fire_detector.is_fire() == true THEN beep() LG_fire_detector
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN light_off() xiaomi_smart_light
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() alway_heater_pro2
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_air_purifier
